title: CFB Top Picks Navigation Step 1 — visible CFB dropdown ownership
trigger: User screenshot on 2026-09-29 shows normal College Football market dropdown exposes Moneyline, Over/Under, and Game Total but not Top Picks.
root_cause: The certified V244 Top Picks route owns direct/cold Top Picks activation, but normal non-Top-Picks rendering delegates through frozen router layers whose visible CFB selector options remain the pre-Top-Picks three-market set. V241 mutates an older CFB_MARKETS owner, which is not a reliable top-level presentation hook for the current normal navigation chain.
patch: Add V245 over frozen V244 and wrap only the rendered 🎯 CFB Market selectbox, appending Top Picks once while preserving the supplied existing options. Activate V245 in app.py.
